scope: Unchanged SDK advertising init and every encode family, actual source memory, guarded outputs/contexts, short/full names, UUID-size queries/writes, manufacturer/service/connection records, size/error propagation and init-to-start sequences
limitations: Controller/identity/appearance/name/UUID replies are deterministic SVC fixtures, not actual SoftDevice execution.
Only mapped valid pointers and bounded output spans are covered. Any source-observed writes beyond a supplied capacity are preserved, not a safety or protocol-conformance claim.
Canonical bool values are used. Product-owned initializer values/callbacks, all application writers, original allocation identity, byte identity, full-image linking and hardware remain open.
